itemizedResolutions.action: Implemented /api/auth/apple in lib/oauth.js and lib/social.js with full JWT claim verification (iss: https://appleid.apple.com, exp, sub, aud), account lookup in oauth_accounts(provider='apple'), repeat-login resolution without email/name, and secure user creation without fabricating fake privaterelay emails. Added com.apple.developer.applesignin entitlement to ios/Kinnect/Resources/Kinnect.entitlements and AuthenticationServices.framework in ios/project.yml. Added 6 automated end-to-end contract assertions in test/test_live_and_contracts_e2e.mjs (100% pass).

itemizedResolutions.point: P1 VIDEO UI STATE & LIVE PREVIEW / SAVE DISAMBIGUATION
itemizedResolutions.action: Instantiated persistent videoProject upon camera capture, library picking, and fixture initialization in CameraStudioView.swift. Connected StudioVideoPlayerView to playerItem.videoComposition via reactive revisionId observer for real-time live preview of color filters and skin smoothing during playback. Disambiguated saveMediaToPhotos() by strict isVideoActive branching: video editing strictly executes vp.exportVideo() and UISaveVideoAtPathToSavedPhotosAlbum, completely eliminating any possibility of saving a photo instead of video. Added UI Trim sliders (trimIn, trimOut) and 90-degree rotation cycling in the crop tool panel.

Rewrote LocalizationManager.swift in clean UTF-8 encoding (eliminating previous mojibake character corruptions) with full bilingual VI/EN dictionary coverage for all Auth, Register, Forgot Password, and Studio Pro strings. Wrapped 100% of user-facing Text literals in AuthView.swift in L10n.tr() and verified reactive updates via @ObservedObject private var loc = LocalizationManager.shared.

Preserved 67 pending substates strictly marked as PENDING_SUBSTATE_VERIFICATION in req-ios-layout-every-page-20261107.json. No premature claim of App Store readiness or physical submission without device evidence.
